activity.title: An auction can be extended until it closes, from the auction header
body: A live auction’s closing time can be changed by the buyer who created it, up until the moment it closes. Participants are notified automatically and the extension is recorded on the auction’s audit trail.

activity.title: Open the auction, choose Extend, and set the new closing time.
body: Open the auction from Sourcing → Auctions, choose Extend on the auction header, and set the new closing time. It can be extended any number of times while the auction is still live.
Every participant is emailed the new deadline automatically, and the change is recorded on the auction’s audit trail with your name against it.
Once an auction has closed it cannot be extended — you would need to clone it into a new round instead.

activity.title: Root cause: JWT_ISSUER was set to the API host instead of the auth host
body: The deployment manifest sets JWT_ISSUER to api.acmecloud.com. Tokens are minted with issuer auth.acmecloud.com, so every token fails the issuer check and the service returns 401 — correctly, against the wrong expectation.

data.subject: Webhook delivery issue resolved — ACME-7804
body: Hi Northwind Ltd,
Your events were being abandoned because your endpoint’s response time is longer than the retry budget configured on your tenant, so slow-but-successful deliveries were dropped before they completed.
We have raised the budget on your tenant and replayed the deliveries that were abandoned, so nothing is lost. We have also added an alert so this surfaces to us next time instead of to you.
No change to your integration is needed on your side.

decisions.note: Budget raised and deliveries replayed. Alert added.

memory.title: GST omitted entirely on renewal invoices
memory.symptom: Invoice generated with no tax line for a tenant that has GST configured
memory.rootCause: The renewal invoice path built its own line items and never called the tax step, so GST was skipped rather than miscalculated.
memory.resolution: Route renewal invoices through the same calculator as new invoices. PR #331.

memory.title: Approval matrix ignores the delegated approver
memory.symptom: Purchase orders sit unapproved while the delegate reports seeing nothing to approve
memory.rootCause: Delegation was stored on the user but the approval query filtered on the original approver id only.
memory.resolution: Include active delegations in the approver lookup. PR #287.

memory.title: Vendor cannot upload documents over 10 MB
memory.symptom: Document upload fails silently for large files
memory.rootCause: The gateway body limit was lower than the limit advertised in the product.
memory.resolution: Raise the gateway limit to match the documented 25 MB and surface a clear error above it.

memory.title: Tenant-wide 401s traced to an environment variable drift
memory.symptom: All users rejected at login shortly after a release
memory.rootCause: A deployment changed an authentication environment variable and nothing asserted the value at boot.
memory.resolution: Restore the value and add a boot-time assertion so the service refuses to start on a mismatch.

memory.title: Webhook deliveries dropped after a retry budget change
memory.symptom: Downstream systems stop receiving events without any error surfacing to the customer
memory.rootCause: The retry budget was reduced below the p99 downstream latency, so slow endpoints were abandoned.
memory.resolution: Restore the retry budget and alert when the abandon rate crosses 1%.
